name: Philanthropy
overview: Scripture in Isaiah 58 emphasizes that true philanthropy involves actively loosening the bonds of wickedness, relieving heavy burdens, and freeing the oppressed. It calls believers to share their bread with the hungry, welcome the poor into their homes, and clothe the naked without turning away from those in need. When these acts of compassion are practiced, God promises spiritual renewal, guidance, and blessing, portraying philanthropy as a vital expression of righteousness that reflects God's glory and care.
